title: Following the Whispers of Values: Unraveling Neural Mechanisms Behind Value-Oriented Behaviors in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking Large Language Models (LLMs) against Chinese Social Values, which include ethical and moral concepts such as Integrity, Justice, Harmony, and Friendliness. It specifically constructs a bilingual benchmark, C-voice, to measure how models handle value-driven behavioral choices in realistic dilemma scenarios.
